explanation: I grepped the Fin directories in Mathlib and in Lean core (Init/Data/Fin) for `le_sub_one_iff`, `sub_one_lt_iff`, `lt_sub_iff` and `sub_le_iff`. The only matches are in the same file as the target. The neighbouring lemmas `lt_sub_iff` and `sub_le_iff` are general (`a < a - b ↔ a < b`) and live there too. The proof also uses `lt_sub_iff` together with several rewrites, so it is not a one- or two-line derivation. I found no separate declaration stating `k ≤ k - 1 ↔ k = 0` for `Fin`.
